content.title: Review the default top holdings table
content.intent: Prove the holdings card presents the expected eight holdings rows and the required table columns on the dashboard.
content.technique_notes: Techniques: equivalence partitioning over the default holdings-card state, verifying the named row set and required columns as one read-only presentation class. strength=2 by risk judgement because no money, auth, or data-loss factors apply; no covering-array sweep was needed because there is no multi-input combination space in the cited default-state content.
